data.name: Fall Foliage White Mountains Day Trip
data.headline: This tour will be available starting September 15 until 31st of October 2025
data.description:
## About

Discover the stunning colors of New England $1600. This tour will be available starting September 15 until 31st of October.

Available in English, Spanish, Italian and Turkish.

Fully customizable. 

New England is renowned for having some of the most beautiful fall foliage in the country. We will travel through the world renowned Kancamagus Highway. We'll enjoy several stops along this route for pictures. Franconia Notch is one of our stunning mountain passes within the White Mountain National Forest. As we travel north through the "Notch", we will explore the Flume Gorge. This attraction is a natural gorge that you can access via a 2-mile loop trail that winds past covered bridges, glacial erratics, and Avalanche Falls, a 45' waterfall. We will then explore the Basin, the granite pothole created by the glaciers 15, 000 years ago. Then, we will take a walk down to the Old Man Historic Site and Memorial Plaza to learn about the "Great Stone Face" that was viewed and written about for over 200 years before crumbling in 2003. Later in the day, we will take a scenic tour on route 302 to the Mount Washington Hotel, making a quick stop here for pictures of the hotel with views of Mountain Washington.

We will start the day in Boston. We will drive to New Hampshire and start exploring New Hampshire's vibrant and beautiful White Mountains. The White Mountains is world-renowned for its stunning annual display of fall foliage. Beginning in mid-September, the mountain tops and scenic byways of the White Mountains become awash with brilliant reds, yellows, oranges, and even purple hues! This is due to the fact that we have a variety of trees in the White Mountains whose leave change including Sugar Maple, Red, and Striped Maple, White and Yellow Birch, American Beech, Tamarack, and Tamarack, just to name a few. We will drive through the Kancamagus Highway making multiple stops along the way. Then, we will explore Franconia Notch State Park visiting the highlights of the park including Flume Gorge a 2-mile nature walk through the Flume Gorge, a spectacular natural chasm. We'll see covered bridges, amazing waterfalls, a scenic natural pool, and gorgeous mountain views. We will also visit Mount Washington Hotel.
